_doc: The Drowned Oath chapter 10, one against two. Hand-made (tools/maps/build_drowned_oath_maps.py). The Shoal comes up the Whaleroad river from the rivermouth marsh in the south-west. Kettlehall holds the snowfield in the north-east, the Concord under Aldous Wren holds the Hall of the Endless Feast on the frozen downs in the south-east. The clans and the Concord are allied computer players (team 1) at the easy difficulty (one against two). The Shoal needs the Forgewarm Harness on the snow. Laid out on a 34x26 grid and drawn 2.7x larger.
